"""Saved-data contract/count/resource audit; imports no learner or model runtime."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import math
import time
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ARMS = ("trainable", "frozen_producer", "bypass", "frozen", "external")
PHASES = ("actual_before_growth", "alternate_before_growth", "actual_after_growth", "alternate_after_growth")
PARAMS = ("input_weights", "recurrent_weights", "cell_bias", "span_heads", "stop_head", "stop_bias")
ARTIFACT = ROOT / "benchmarks/contextual_rate_cell_acquisition_v1.json"
OUTPUT = ROOT / ".pytest-tmp/contextual-rate-cell-contract-audit-v1.json"


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def require(condition, label):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(label)


def digest(value):
    return sha(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode())


def main():
    began = time.perf_counter()
    inputs = (ARTIFACT, ARTIFACT.with_suffix(".npz"), ROOT / "experiments/r4_integrated/contextual_full_choice_train.json")
    hashes = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in inputs}
    report = json.loads(inputs[0].read_bytes())
    fixture = json.loads(inputs[2].read_bytes())
    arrays = np.load(inputs[1], allow_pickle=False)
    require(report["terminal"] == "completed", "incomplete acquisition")
    require(report["source_revision"] == "414f3920b0f222812944a77bf72d406ae3354960", "frozen revision")
    require(report["source_unchanged"] and report["source_sha256"] == report["source_sha256_after"], "source invariance")
    for path, expected in report["source_sha256"].items():
        require(sha((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == expected, "held source " + path)
    preflight_path = Path(report["numerical_receipt"]["path"])
    preflight = json.loads(preflight_path.read_bytes())
    require(sha(preflight_path.read_bytes()) == report["numerical_receipt"]["sha256"], "preflight hash")
    require(preflight["status"] == "passed" and preflight["elapsed_seconds"] <= 900 and preflight["projected_acquisition_seconds"] <= 1800, "preflight gates")
    require(preflight["source_revision"] == report["source_revision"], "preflight revision")
    require(all(report["source_sha256"].get(k) == v for k, v in preflight["source_sha256"].items()), "preflight source scope")
    require(report["elapsed_seconds"] <= 1800, "acquisition wall cap")
    require(report["limits"] == {"seconds": 1800, "parent_rss_mib": 2048, "retained_payload_bytes": 1024**3}, "declared limits")
    require(set(arrays.files) == set(report["array_sha256"]), "array inventory")
    for key in arrays.files:
        require(sha(arrays[key].tobytes()) == report["array_sha256"][key], "array hash " + key)
        require(np.isfinite(arrays[key]).all(), "finite array " + key)
    require(sum(arrays[k].nbytes for k in arrays.files) == report["audit_array_payload_bytes"], "array payload")
    require(report["checkpoint"]["bytes"] == inputs[1].stat().st_size and report["checkpoint"]["sha256"] == hashes[str(inputs[1].relative_to(ROOT))], "NPZ custody")
    tasks = fixture["tasks"]
    by_id = {t["id"]: t for t in tasks}
    require(len(tasks) == 64 and sum(t["answer"] is not None for t in tasks) == 48, "teacher inventory")
    require(len(report["training"]) == 256 and set(report["phases"]) == set(PHASES), "run shape")
    train_candidates = report["training_inventory"]["candidates"]
    grown_candidates = report["grown_inventory"]["candidates"]
    require(len(train_candidates) == 8162 and len(grown_candidates) == 10864 and grown_candidates[:8162] == train_candidates, "append-only candidate inventory")
    work = Path(report["workspace_root"]).resolve()
    paths, execution_counts = set(), Counter()

    def execution(row, task, teacher=False):
        receipt = row if teacher else row["execution"]
        folder = Path(receipt["workspace"]).resolve()
        require(folder.is_relative_to(work) and folder not in paths, "unique retained execution workspace")
        paths.add(folder)
        names = {p.name for p in folder.iterdir()}
        module = task["workspace"]["module"]
        require(names == {module + ".py", "main.py", "decoy.py"}, "source-absent execution files")
        before = f"{task['workspace']['key']} = '{task['workspace']['stale']}'\n".encode()
        source = (folder / (module + ".py")).read_bytes()
        statements = ast.parse(source).body
        require(len(statements) == 1 and isinstance(statements[0], ast.Assign), "single literal action")
        assignment = statements[0]
        require(len(assignment.targets) == 1 and isinstance(assignment.targets[0], ast.Name) and assignment.targets[0].id == task["workspace"]["key"], "action target key")
        value = ast.literal_eval(assignment.value)
        require(isinstance(value, str), "literal value type")
        require((folder / "decoy.py").read_bytes() == b"foreign = 'spare'\n", "retained decoy")
        expected_main = (f"import {module}\nprint(next(v for k, v in vars({module}).items() " + "if not k.startswith('_')))\n").encode()
        require((folder / "main.py").read_bytes() == expected_main, "retained Python execution program")
        require(receipt["decoys_unchanged"] and receipt["materialized_matches_action"], "materialized execution custody")
        require(receipt["returncode"] == 0 and receipt["stderr"] == "" and receipt["stdout"].strip() == value, "execution output agrees retained action")
        target = (task["answer"] or task["workspace"]["stale"]) if teacher else (task["answer"] or "__unsupported__")
        require(receipt["passed"] == (value == target), "independent execution success")
        if teacher:
            require(receipt["passed"] and receipt["workspace_unchanged"] == (source == before), "teacher authorized action")
            require(receipt["teacher_kind"] == ("authorized_exact_answer" if task["answer"] is not None else "authorized_absent_evidence_stop"), "teacher authority kind")
            require(receipt["answer_hex"] == (None if task["answer"] is None else task["answer"].encode().hex()), "teacher exact answer")
        else:
            selected = row["selection"]
            require(row["case"] == task["id"] and row["expected_value"] == task["answer"], "case identity")
            require(row["live_document_count"] == 0 and row["edited"] == (source != before), "source-absent/motor edit")
            require(row["evidence_correct"] == (selected["emitted"] == task["answer"]), "evidence exactness")
            require(row["correct_no_action"] == (task["answer"] is None and selected["stopped"] and source == before), "correct no-action contract")
            if not selected["stopped"] and row["edited"]:
                require(value == selected["emitted"], "motor literal receipt binding")
        execution_counts["teacher" if teacher else "learner"] += 1

    def selection(row, arm, query, source):
        s = row["selection"]
        require(s["mode"] == arm and s["query"] == query, "selection mode/query")
        candidates = train_candidates if source == report["training_inventory"]["sha256"] else grown_candidates
        require(s["storage_sha256"] == source, "selection source universe")
        require(s["stopped"] == (s["candidate_index"] is None), "STOP identity")
        if s["stopped"]:
            require(s["emitted"] is None, "STOP output")
        else:
            require(s["emitted"].encode().hex() == candidates[s["candidate_index"]]["emitted_hex"], "selected occurrence bytes")
        if arm != "external":
            require((s["p_stop"] >= .5) == (s["stop_reason"] == "answerability_STOP"), "hierarchical STOP gate")
        raw = dict(s)
        raw.pop("stopped")
        require(raw.pop("eligibility_sha256") == sha(b""), "no old eligibility vector")
        raw["eligibility"] = []
        raw["query"] = query.encode().hex()
        raw["emitted"] = None if s["emitted"] is None else s["emitted"].encode().hex()
        raw["sha256"] = ""
        require(digest(raw) == s["sha256"], "decision digest")

    def summary(rows, ordered):
        out = {"supported": 0, "executed_success": 0, "unsupported": 0, "correct_stop": 0, "groups": {}}
        for row, task in zip(rows, ordered, strict=True):
            supported = task["answer"] is not None
            good = row["execution"]["passed"] if supported else row["correct_no_action"]
            out["supported" if supported else "unsupported"] += 1
            out["executed_success" if supported else "correct_stop"] += int(good)
            groups = ["role:" + task["property"], "form:" + task["query_form_group"], "length:" + str(len(task["answer"].split())) if supported else "answerability:unsupported"]
            for name in groups:
                item = out["groups"].setdefault(name, {"count": 0, "correct": 0})
                item["count"] += 1
                item["correct"] += int(good)
        out["correct_total"] = out["executed_success"] + out["correct_stop"]
        return out

    offers = {arm: Counter() for arm in ARMS}
    previous = {}
    for step, row in enumerate(report["training"], 1):
        require(row["step"] == step and row["pass"] == (step-1)//64+1 and row["task"] == fixture["schedule"][step-1], "fixed encounter order")
        task = by_id[row["task"]]
        require(set(row["first"]) == set(row["lessons"]) == set(row["new"]) == set(ARMS), "five own first attempts")
        require(set(row["replay"]) == (set(ARMS) if step > 1 else set()), "one prior-lesson replay")
        execution(row["teacher"], task, True)
        for arm in ARMS:
            first, lesson = row["first"][arm], row["lessons"][arm]
            execution(first, task)
            selection(first, arm, task["query"], report["training_inventory"]["sha256"])
            require(json.loads(lesson["attempt_json"]) == {**first["execution"], "own_decision_sha256": first["selection"]["sha256"]}, "own executed attempt binding")
            require(json.loads(lesson["teacher_json"]) == row["teacher"], "shared authentic teacher")
            require(lesson["original"]["sha256"] == first["selection"]["sha256"], "own original decision")
            for kind in ("new", "replay"):
                if arm not in row[kind]:
                    continue
                receipt = row[kind][arm]
                old = lesson if kind == "new" else previous[arm]
                require(receipt["lesson_sha256"] == old["sha256"] and receipt["own_decision_sha256"] == old["original"]["sha256"], "immutable replay lesson")
                require(receipt["source_pool_sha256"] == report["training_inventory"]["sha256"], "fixed training source pool")
                require(not receipt["new_execution_credit"] and not receipt["native_update_applied"], "surrogate gradient credit disclosure")
                active = [] if arm in ("frozen", "external") else [p for p in PARAMS if not ((arm in ("bypass", "frozen_producer") and p in PARAMS[:3]) or (old["answer"] is None and p == "span_heads"))]
                require(receipt["active_parameters"] == active, "arm/STOP optimizer mask")
                for p in PARAMS:
                    require(receipt["adam_steps_after"][p] == receipt["adam_steps_before"][p] + int(p in active), "masked Adam step")
                offers[arm][kind] += 1
                offers[arm]["updates"] += int(receipt["parameter_update_applied"])
            previous[arm] = lesson
    for number, saved in enumerate(report["pass_summaries"], 1):
        rows = [r for r in report["training"] if r["pass"] == number]
        for arm in ARMS:
            require(summary([r["first"][arm] for r in rows], [by_id[r["task"]] for r in rows]) == saved[arm], "independent pass summary")
    summaries = {}
    for phase in PHASES:
        source = report["grown_inventory"]["sha256"] if "after" in phase else report["training_inventory"]["sha256"]
        summaries[phase] = {}
        for arm in ARMS:
            result = report["phases"][phase][arm]
            require(len(result["rows"]) == 64, "phase task count")
            for row, task in zip(result["rows"], tasks, strict=True):
                execution(row, task)
                query = fixture["alternate_queries"][task["id"]] if phase.startswith("alternate") else task["query"]
                selection(row, arm, query, source)
                require(("diagnostics" in row) == (arm == "trainable"), "256 updater diagnostic scope")
            summaries[phase][arm] = summary(result["rows"], tasks)
            require(summaries[phase][arm] == result["summary"], "independent phase summary")
    require(execution_counts == {"teacher": 256, "learner": 2560} and len(paths) == 2816, "2816 real execution receipts")
    for arm in ARMS:
        require(offers[arm]["new"] == 256 and offers[arm]["replay"] == 255, "511 offers per arm")
        require(report["trained"][arm]["core"]["offer_count"] == 511 and report["trained"][arm]["core"]["update_count"] == offers[arm]["updates"], "actual update counter")
        require(report["trained"][arm]["core"] == report["end"][arm]["core"], "updates-off state counters")
        keys = report["initial"][arm]["core"]["array_sha256"]
        for key in keys:
            require(np.array_equal(arrays[f"trained_{arm}_{key}"], arrays[f"final_{arm}_{key}"]), "growth/evaluation state unchanged")
            require(np.array_equal(arrays[f"initial_trainable_{key}"], arrays[f"initial_{arm}_{key}"]), "matched initial arrays")
            if arm in ("frozen", "external"):
                require(np.array_equal(arrays[f"initial_{arm}_{key}"], arrays[f"final_{arm}_{key}"]), "fully frozen arrays")
        if arm in ("frozen", "external"):
            require(offers[arm]["updates"] == 0, "frozen zero mutation")
    treatment = {phase: summaries[phase]["trainable"] for phase in PHASES}
    threshold = {label: treatment[phase]["executed_success"] >= 44 and treatment[phase]["correct_stop"] >= 15 for label, phase in (("before_growth", PHASES[0]), ("after_growth", PHASES[2]))}
    groups = {phase: all(5*g["correct"] >= 4*g["count"] for g in s["groups"].values()) for phase, s in treatment.items()}
    stop = {phase: s["correct_stop"] >= 15 for phase, s in treatment.items()}
    growth = treatment[PHASES[0]]["correct_total"] - treatment[PHASES[2]]["correct_total"] <= 3
    contribution = {f"{phase}:{control}": {"supported_advantage": treatment[phase]["executed_success"] - summaries[phase][control]["executed_success"], "stop_advantage": treatment[phase]["correct_stop"] - summaries[phase][control]["correct_stop"]} for phase in (PHASES[0], PHASES[2]) for control in ("frozen_producer", "bypass")}
    gate = report["acquisition_gate"]
    require(gate["actual_thresholds"] == threshold and gate["all_declared_groups_at_least_80_percent"] == groups and gate["all_phase_stop_thresholds"] == stop and gate["growth_loss_at_most_five_percentage_points"] == growth and gate["learned_cell_contribution"] == contribution, "independent gate components")
    passed = all(threshold.values()) and all(groups.values()) and all(stop.values()) and growth and all(v["supported_advantage"] >= 8 and v["stop_advantage"] >= 0 for v in contribution.values())
    require(gate["passed"] == passed, "independent adoption gate")
    resource_rows = [report["resources_after_ingestion"], *report["resources_by_pass"], report["resources_after_growth"], report["final_resources"]]
    require(len(resource_rows) == 7, "resource checkpoint count")
    for r in resource_rows:
        require(r["counted_payload_bytes"] == r["python_numpy_learner_and_motor_bytes"] + r["encoder_file_bytes"], "resource arithmetic")
        require(r["counted_payload_bytes"] <= 1024**3 and r["parent_memory"]["peak_working_set_mib"] <= 2048, "measured resource limits")
    require(report["parent_memory"]["peak_working_set_mib"] <= 2048, "final peak RSS")
    require(len(report["motor_demonstrations"]) == 2 and all(x["execution"]["passed"] for x in report["motor_demonstrations"]), "two disclosed motor demonstrations")
    require(all(sha(p.read_bytes()) == hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in inputs), "immutable audit inputs")
    result = {"status": "passed", "scope": "independent saved-data contract/count/resource/gate audit; no inference/training/child execution", "input_sha256": hashes, "auditor_sha256": sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), "elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter()-began, "execution_counts": dict(execution_counts), "total_executions_excluding_two_motor_demonstrations": len(paths), "offers": offers, "summaries": summaries, "independent_gate": {"passed": passed, "actual_thresholds": threshold, "groups": groups, "STOP": stop, "growth": growth, "contribution": contribution}, "resources": {"acquisition_seconds": report["elapsed_seconds"], "preflight_seconds": preflight["elapsed_seconds"], "projected_acquisition_seconds": preflight["projected_acquisition_seconds"], "parent_peak_working_set_mib": report["parent_memory"]["peak_working_set_mib"], "max_counted_payload_bytes": max(r["counted_payload_bytes"] for r in resource_rows), "max_audit_retained_bytes": max(r["audit_retained_bytes"] for r in resource_rows), "array_payload_bytes": report["audit_array_payload_bytes"], "compressed_npz_bytes": inputs[1].stat().st_size}, "limits": "RSS/resource samples are recorded host measurements, not an independent OS trace. Final JSON serialization is excluded from the runner wall-time field. Numerical BPTT/Adam replay and complete token custody are audited separately."}
    with OUTPUT.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        json.dump(result, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ("status", "elapsed_seconds", "execution_counts", "offers", "independent_gate", "resources")}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import ast
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import fields, is_dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PATH = ROOT / "benchmarks/contextual_rate_cell_acquisition_v1.json"
report = json.loads(PATH.read_bytes())
archive = np.load(PATH.with_suffix(".npz"), allow_pickle=False)
source = ROOT / "experiments/r4_integrated/contextual_rate_cell_python_session.py"
tree = ast.parse(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
function = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "retained_size")
namespace = {"sys": sys, "np": np, "Mapping": Mapping, "fields": fields, "is_dataclass": is_dataclass}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]), str(source), "exec"), namespace)
original_size = namespace["retained_size"]


class Probe:
    pass


probe = Probe()
probe.state = np.zeros(1000, dtype=np.float64)
omitted = original_size(probe)
probe.__class__.__module__ = "experiments.r4_integrated.synthetic_probe"
traversed = original_size(probe)
assert omitted == sys.getsizeof(probe) and traversed >= omitted + probe.state.nbytes


def size(*roots):
    total, seen, pending = 0, set(), list(roots)
    while pending:
        value = pending.pop()
        if id(value) in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(id(value))
        total += sys.getsizeof(value)
        if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
            if value.base is not None:
                pending.append(value.base)
        elif isinstance(value, Mapping):
            pending.extend(value.keys())
            pending.extend(value.values())
        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set, frozenset)):
            pending.extend(value)
    return total


arms = ("trainable", "frozen_producer", "bypass", "frozen", "external")
model = {
    arm: {name: archive[f"final_{arm}_{name}"] for name in report["end"][arm]["core"]["array_sha256"]}
    for arm in arms
}
model_checkpoint_bytes = sum(a.nbytes for state in model.values() for a in state.values())
model_float_array_bytes = sum(a.nbytes for state in model.values() for name, a in state.items() if name != "adam_steps")
assert model_checkpoint_bytes == 5 * 698952
assert model_float_array_bytes == 5 * 3 * 232968
tokens = [{"record": row, "raw": bytes.fromhex(row["raw_hex"]), "vectors": archive[row["array"]]} for row in report["input_records"]]
token_array_bytes = sum(t["vectors"].nbytes for t in tokens)
raw_source_bytes = sum(len(t["raw"]) for t in tokens if t["record"]["kind"] != "query")
raw_query_bytes = sum(len(t["raw"]) for t in tokens if t["record"]["kind"] == "query")
queries = {t["raw"]: t for t in tokens if t["record"]["kind"] == "query"}
query_mappings = [dict(queries) for _ in arms]
candidate_rows = report["grown_inventory"]["candidates"]
emitted_bytes = sum(len(bytes.fromhex(row["emitted_hex"])) for row in candidate_rows)
local_span_array_bytes = len(candidate_rows) * 2 * 8

# overhead than compact live slot objects. They provide a conservative practical
# reconstruction estimate, not a claimed historical object-identity measurement.
local_spans = np.zeros((len(candidate_rows), 2), dtype=np.int64)
last_lessons = report["training"][-1]["lessons"]
saved_object_estimate = size(model, tokens, query_mappings, candidate_rows, local_spans, last_lessons, report["end"])
old_final = report["final_resources"]
encoder_bytes = old_final["encoder_file_bytes"]
corrected_estimate = saved_object_estimate + old_final["python_numpy_learner_and_motor_bytes"] + encoder_bytes
exact_numerical_and_raw_payload = model_float_array_bytes + token_array_bytes + raw_source_bytes + raw_query_bytes + local_span_array_bytes
assert corrected_estimate < 1024**3
assert report["parent_memory"]["peak_working_set_mib"] < 2048

    "artifact_sha256": hashlib.sha256(PATH.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "diagnosis": "ExecutedReader class is __main__ when the runner uses -m. retained_size follows ordinary objects only for humanbrain./experiments.r4_integrated. modules, so all five reader cores, inventories and query mappings were omitted. The imported motor and previous dataclass lessons were traversed.",
    "synthetic_same_object_module_probe": {"own_object_bytes": sys.getsizeof(probe), "contained_array_bytes": probe.state.nbytes, "main_module_reported_bytes": omitted, "project_module_reported_bytes": traversed},
    "invalid_recorded_learner_payload": {"initial_python_numpy_bytes": report["resources_after_ingestion"]["python_numpy_learner_and_motor_bytes"], "final_python_numpy_bytes": old_final["python_numpy_learner_and_motor_bytes"], "final_counted_with_encoder_bytes": old_final["counted_payload_bytes"]},

Execution, gate, hash and numerical-state facts remain independently checkable."},

"""Read-only audit of completed rate-cell execution workspaces; never executes code."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def digest(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


artifact = ROOT / 'benchmarks/contextual_rate_cell_acquisition_v1.json'
result = json.loads(artifact.read_text())
assert result['terminal'] == 'completed'
fixture_path = ROOT / 'experiments/r4_integrated/contextual_full_choice_train.json'
fixture = json.loads(fixture_path.read_text())
tasks = {task['id']: task for task in fixture['tasks']}
work = Path(result['workspace_root']).resolve()
assert work.is_relative_to(ROOT / '.runtime')
rows, seen = [], set()


def check(execution, config, actual, expected, label):
    folder = Path(execution['workspace']).resolve()
    assert folder.is_relative_to(work) and folder not in seen
    seen.add(folder)
    key, module = config['key'], config['module']
    contents = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in folder.iterdir() if p.is_file()}
    assert set(contents) == {f'{module}.py', 'main.py', 'decoy.py'}, label
    assert not any(p.is_dir() for p in folder.iterdir()), label
    assert contents['decoy.py'] == b"foreign = 'spare'\n", label
    main = (f'import {module}\n'
            f'print(next(v for k, v in vars({module}).items() '
            "if not k.startswith('_')))\n").encode()
    assert contents['main.py'] == main, label
    tree = ast.parse(contents[f'{module}.py'])
    assert len(tree.body) == 1 and isinstance(tree.body[0], ast.Assign), label
    assignment = tree.body[0]
    assert len(assignment.targets) == 1 and assignment.targets[0].id == key, label
    assert ast.literal_eval(assignment.value) == actual, label
    assert execution['returncode'] == 0 and execution['stderr'] == '', label
    assert execution['stdout'].rstrip('\r\n') == actual, label
    assert execution['passed'] == (actual == expected), label
    assert execution['decoys_unchanged'] and execution['materialized_matches_action'], label
    rows.append({'label': label, 'passed': execution['passed'],
                 'workspace': str(folder.relative_to(work)),
                 'files': {name: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() for name, raw in contents.items()},
                 'bytes': sum(map(len, contents.values()))})


def learner(row, task, label):
    emitted = row['selection']['emitted']
    assert row['selection']['stopped'] == (emitted is None), label
    assert row['evidence_correct'] == (emitted == task['answer']), label
    assert row['expected_value'] == task['answer'] and row['live_document_count'] == 0, label
    actual = emitted if row['edited'] else task['workspace']['stale']
    assert row['correct_no_action'] == (task['answer'] is None and emitted is None and not row['edited']), label
    check(row['execution'], task['workspace'], actual, task['answer'] or '__unsupported__', label)


for step in result['training']:
    task = tasks[step['task']]
    for arm, row in step['first'].items():
        learner(row, task, f'train/{step["step"]}/{arm}')
    teacher_value = task['answer'] or task['workspace']['stale']
    check(step['teacher'], task['workspace'], teacher_value, teacher_value, f'teacher/{step["step"]}')
for phase, arms in result['phases'].items():
    for arm, data in arms.items():
        for row in data['rows']:
            learner(row, tasks[row['case']], f'{phase}/{arm}/{row["case"]}')
for row, (key, module, value) in zip(result['motor_demonstrations'],
                                  [('axel','motor_alpha','fresh'), ('bora','motor_beta','ready')], strict=True):
    check(row['execution'], {'key':key, 'module':module}, value, value, row['case'])
assert len(rows) == 2818
out = {'status': 'passed', 'scope': 'Read-only saved workspace/source and stdout consistency; no re-execution.',
       'source_artifact_sha256': digest(artifact),
       'fixture_sha256': digest(fixture_path),
       'checker_sha256': digest(Path(__file__)),
       'checker_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
       'checked_workspaces': len(rows), 'checked_files': len(rows)*3,
       'materialized_file_bytes': sum(row['bytes'] for row in rows), 'rows': rows}
output = ROOT / '.pytest-tmp/rate-cell-execution-audit.json'
with output.open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
    json.dump(out, stream, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({key:value for key,value in out.items() if key != 'rows'}))

"""Independent synthetic rate-cell objective/BPTT reference; no learner imports."""
from __future__ import annotations
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
import numpy as np


def all_spans(documents):
    return [(window,left,right) for window,doc in enumerate(documents)
            for left in range(len(doc)) for right in range(left+1,len(doc)+1)]


def lse(x):
    maximum=float(np.max(x))
    return maximum+math.log(math.fsum(math.exp(float(v)-maximum) for v in x))


def forward(parameters, query, documents, spans, *, bypass=False):
    """Independent loop forward; right endpoints exclusive, windows reset."""
    W,U,b=parameters['W'],parameters['U'],parameters['b']
    states=[];trajectories=[];query_inputs=[np.append(x,[1.,0.]) for x in query]
    for document in documents:
        inputs=np.asarray(query_inputs+[np.append(x,[0.,1.]) for x in document])
        if bypass:
            query_mean=np.mean(query,axis=0) if len(query) else np.zeros(W.shape[1]-2)
            projected_query=W@np.append(query_mean,[1.,0.])
            document_states=np.asarray([np.tanh(W@np.append(x,[0.,1.])+projected_query+b) for x in document])
            trajectories.append(None)
        else:
            previous=np.zeros(U.shape[0]);trace=[]
            for x in inputs:
                activation=np.tanh(W@x+U@previous+b)
                current=.5*previous+.5*activation
                trace.append((x,previous.copy(),activation,current.copy()))
                previous=current
            document_states=np.stack([row[3] for row in trace[len(query):]])
            trajectories.append(trace)
        states.append(document_states)
    scores=[]
    A,B,C=parameters['span']
    for window,left,right in spans:
        h=states[window]
        scores.append(float(A@h[left]+B@h[right-1]+C@np.mean(h[left:right],axis=0)))
    total_words=sum(len(h) for h in states)
    pooled=sum((h.sum(axis=0) for h in states),np.zeros(U.shape[0]))/total_words
    stop=float(parameters['stop']@pooled+parameters['stop_bias'][0])
    return {'scores':np.array(scores),'stop_logit':stop,'states':states,'traces':trajectories,'pooled':pooled}


def objective_and_gradient(parameters, query, documents, spans, gold, *, bypass=False):
    """Scalar objective plus independent manual reverse accumulation."""
    result=forward(parameters,query,documents,spans,bypass=bypass)
    z=result['stop_logit'];stop_target=gold is None
    gate_loss=max(z,0)+math.log1p(math.exp(-abs(z)))-int(stop_target)*z
    sigmoid=(1/(1+math.exp(-z))) if z>=0 else math.exp(z)/(1+math.exp(z))
    dz=sigmoid-int(stop_target)
    gradient={key:np.zeros_like(value) for key,value in parameters.items()}
    gradient['stop']=dz*result['pooled'];gradient['stop_bias'][0]=dz
    total_words=sum(len(h) for h in result['states'])
    state_grad=[np.tile(dz*parameters['stop']/total_words,(len(h),1)) for h in result['states']]
    span_loss=0.
    if gold is not None:
        assert len(gold)>0 and len(set(gold))==len(gold)
        scores=result['scores'];normalizer=lse(scores);gold_normalizer=lse(scores[list(gold)])
        span_loss=normalizer-gold_normalizer
        coefficients=np.exp(scores-normalizer)
        for index in gold:coefficients[index]-=math.exp(float(scores[index])-gold_normalizer)
        for coefficient,(window,left,right) in zip(coefficients,spans,strict=True):
            h=result['states'][window];gh=state_grad[window]
            gradient['span'][0]+=coefficient*h[left]
            gradient['span'][1]+=coefficient*h[right-1]
            gradient['span'][2]+=coefficient*np.mean(h[left:right],axis=0)
            gh[left]+=coefficient*parameters['span'][0]
            gh[right-1]+=coefficient*parameters['span'][1]
            gh[left:right]+=coefficient*parameters['span'][2]/(right-left)
    if not bypass:
        for trace,direct in zip(result['traces'],state_grad,strict=True):
            carry=np.zeros(parameters['U'].shape[0])
            for t in range(len(trace)-1,-1,-1):
                x,previous,activation,_=trace[t]
                adjoint=carry.copy()
                if t>=len(query):adjoint+=direct[t-len(query)]
                da=.5*adjoint*(1-activation*activation)
                gradient['W']+=np.outer(da,x)
                gradient['U']+=np.outer(da,previous)
                gradient['b']+=da
                carry=.5*adjoint+parameters['U'].T@da
    return {'loss':gate_loss+span_loss,'gate_loss':gate_loss,'span_loss':span_loss,'gradient':gradient,**result}


def finite_difference(parameters,query,documents,spans,gold,coordinates, *, bypass=False,epsilon=1e-6):
    records=[]
    for key,index in coordinates:
        original=float(parameters[key][index]);losses=[]
        for sign in (-1,1):
            parameters[key][index]=original+sign*epsilon
            losses.append(objective_and_gradient(parameters,query,documents,spans,gold,bypass=bypass)['loss'])
        parameters[key][index]=original
        records.append((key,index,(losses[1]-losses[0])/(2*epsilon)))
    return records


def independent_adam(parameters, moments, variances, counters, gradient, active, *, rate=.001,clip=1.):
    """Only listed parameters affect norm or advance moments/counters."""
    squared=math.fsum(float(x)*float(x) for key in active for x in gradient[key].flat)
    norm=math.sqrt(squared);scale=min(1.,clip/norm) if norm else 1.
    output={key:value.copy() for key,value in parameters.items()}
    m={key:value.copy() for key,value in moments.items()};v={key:value.copy() for key,value in variances.items()};t=dict(counters)
    for key in active:
        g=gradient[key]*scale;t[key]+=1
        m[key]=.9*m[key]+.1*g;v[key]=.999*v[key]+.001*g*g
        output[key]-=rate*(m[key]/(1-.9**t[key]))/(np.sqrt(v[key]/(1-.999**t[key]))+1e-8)
    return output,m,v,t,{'norm':norm,'scale':scale}


def selfcheck():
    rng=np.random.default_rng(1703);hidden=3;inputs=4
    p={'W':rng.normal(0,.15,(hidden,inputs+2)),'U':rng.normal(0,.12,(hidden,hidden)),
       'b':rng.normal(0,.03,hidden),'span':rng.normal(0,.1,(3,hidden)),
       'stop':rng.normal(0,.1,hidden),'stop_bias':np.array([.02])}
    query=rng.normal(0,.3,(2,inputs));docs=[rng.normal(0,.3,(3,inputs)),rng.normal(0,.3,(8,inputs))]
    spans=all_spans(docs);gold=[spans.index((0,0,3)),spans.index((1,2,6))]
    coordinates=[(key,index) for key,value in p.items() for index in np.ndindex(value.shape)]
    errors=[]
    for targets in (gold,None):
        expected=objective_and_gradient(p,query,docs,spans,targets)
        for key,index,numerical in finite_difference(p,query,docs,spans,targets,coordinates):
            error=abs(numerical-expected['gradient'][key][index]);errors.append(error)
            assert error<2e-7,(targets,key,index,error)
        if targets is None:assert expected['span_loss']==0 and not np.any(expected['gradient']['span'])
    by=forward(p,query,docs,spans,bypass=True);other=forward(p,query+.2,docs,spans,bypass=True)
    assert np.max(np.abs(by['scores']-other['scores']))>1e-6
    moments={key:np.full_like(value,.01) for key,value in p.items()};variances={key:np.full_like(value,.02) for key,value in p.items()};counters={key:7 for key in p}
    g=objective_and_gradient(p,query,docs,spans,None)['gradient']
    post,m,v,t,_=independent_adam(p,moments,variances,counters,g,[key for key in p if key!='span'])
    assert np.array_equal(post['span'],p['span']) and np.array_equal(m['span'],moments['span']) and np.array_equal(v['span'],variances['span']) and t['span']==7
    return {'status':'passed','scope':'Synthetic independent reference selfcheck only, no core parity or acquisition claim.',
            'finite_difference_coordinates_per_objective':len(coordinates),'objectives':['duplicate-supported','STOP'],
            'max_abs_finite_difference_error':max(errors),'unequal_window_word_counts':[3,8],
            'bypass_query_dependence':True,'STOP_inactive_nonzero_moments_frozen':True,
            'script_sha256':sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}


if __name__=='__main__':print(json.dumps(selfcheck(),indent=2))
